security_justification.audit_integrity: The conformance suite and the kit gate prove every demonstrated event arrives valid and byte-identical, and no document or example claims a delivery the sink did not acknowledge.
security_justification.authentication_or_authorization: Distribution needs the owner's SHA-bound approval of an amendment that names evaluators; this version authorizes none, and the example receiver's authenticator is a synthetic fixture.
security_justification.authority_provenance: The authoritativeTenant union only narrows a type; branding, runtime validation and the authority registry are unchanged, and client claims stay distinct from authoritative values.
security_justification.concurrency: The conformance rows and kit runs are independent; the only concurrency is the sink's, governed by add-sdk-node-http-audit-sink, and the kit gate runs its installs sequentially.
security_justification.confidentiality: Evaluator documents and examples use synthetic values only, and the kit ships no credential; the error catalog explains codes without echoing caller data.
security_justification.cryptography: No cryptography is implemented; the kit identity uses SHA-256 digests to identify artifacts, not to establish trust.
security_justification.error_disclosure: The error catalog documents codes, categories and paths only; core sink-failure diagnostics keep F-11's bounded fields with no event identifier.
security_justification.external_security_integration: The kit gate fetches pinned TypeScript releases and pnpm from the npm registry at gate time only; nothing becomes a runtime dependency or reaches a production system.
security_justification.fail_posture: The kit gate fails closed on any missing item, planted defect or unreachable registry, and the authorization fails closed with no evaluator named until an amendment.
security_justification.lifecycle: The evaluation cannot start until the amendment is approved, the fold waits for the evaluation to close, and both changes stay active until the fold.
security_justification.mutation_ownership: Changes are confined to the exact paths in owned_paths and the two canonical capability specs through the fold; no CB-018-owned or governance-core path is touched.
security_justification.privacy_transformation: The evaluation is synthetic-data only with a stop-and-purge condition, and the privacy guidance shows a transformation hook with synthetic key material.
security_justification.resource_retention: The kit is built and installed only in temporary directories outside the repository, which the harness removes even when a step fails.
security_justification.retry_or_redelivery: The documents state the alpha's single-attempt guarantee with no retry, ordering or delivery-class conformance, and re-issued kits carry a new identity.
security_justification.trust_boundary: The example receiver re-runs full SDK validation rather than trusting the collector's structural acceptance, and every kit input is a synthetic fixture.
